sentences.pt: No sábado, Dona Lúcia ia fazer setenta anos, e o neto Rafael queria fazer o almoço sozinho.
sentences.en: On Saturday, Dona Lúcia was turning seventy, and her grandson Rafael wanted to make lunch by himself.

sentences.pt: Ele nunca tinha cozinhado para muitas pessoas, mas estava animado.
sentences.en: He had never cooked for a lot of people, but he was excited.

sentences.pt: Na sexta-feira à noite, foi ao supermercado com a receita no celular.
sentences.en: On Friday night, he went to the supermarket with the recipe on his phone.

sentences.pt: Comprou frango, batatas, cebola, alho, tomates e farinha para o bolo de laranja.
sentences.en: He bought chicken, potatoes, onion, garlic, tomatoes and flour for the orange cake.

sentences.pt: No sábado, acordou às sete e começou pelo frango.
sentences.en: On Saturday, he woke up at seven and started with the chicken.

sentences.pt: Temperou a carne com sal, alho, pimenta e um pouco de vinho branco.
sentences.en: He seasoned the meat with salt, garlic, pepper and a little white wine.

sentences.pt: Depois descascou as batatas, cortou a cebola em fatias e colocou tudo no forno.
sentences.en: Then he peeled the potatoes, cut the onion into slices and put everything in the oven.

sentences.pt: Enquanto o frango assava, ele começou a fazer o bolo, seguindo a receita da avó.
sentences.en: While the chicken was roasting, he started making the cake, following his grandmother's recipe.

sentences.pt: Misturou os ovos, o açúcar, o suco de laranja, o leite e três xícaras de farinha.
sentences.en: He mixed the eggs, the sugar, the orange juice, the milk and three cups of flour.

sentences.pt: Meia hora depois, no entanto, percebeu que o bolo não tinha crescido nada.
sentences.en: Half an hour later, however, he noticed that the cake hadn't risen at all.

sentences.pt: Ele olhou o fermento e viu que estava vencido desde março.
sentences.en: He looked at the baking powder and saw that it had been expired since March.

sentences.pt: Faltava apenas uma hora para a chegada dos convidados, e as padarias do bairro estavam fechadas.
sentences.en: There was only one hour left before the guests arrived, and the bakeries in the neighborhood were closed.

sentences.pt: Rafael ficou muito preocupado e ligou para a tia Fernanda.
sentences.en: Rafael got very worried and called his aunt Fernanda.

sentences.pt: "Calma", disse ela. "Corte o bolo em quadrados pequenos e coloque em tigelas com sorvete e chocolate."
sentences.en: "Calm down," she said. "Cut the cake into small squares and put it in bowls with ice cream and chocolate."

sentences.pt: Ela mesma trouxe o sorvete, porque morava a dois quarteirões dali.
sentences.en: She brought the ice cream herself, because she lived two blocks away.

sentences.pt: Ao meio-dia, a família toda chegou com flores e presentes.
sentences.en: At noon, the whole family arrived with flowers and presents.

sentences.pt: O frango estava gostoso, e as batatas, douradas e macias.
sentences.en: The chicken was tasty, and the potatoes golden and soft.

sentences.pt: Na hora da sobremesa, Rafael trouxe o bolo em tigelas, com sorvete e chocolate.
sentences.en: At dessert time, Rafael brought the cake in bowls, with ice cream and chocolate.

sentences.pt: Dona Lúcia provou e perguntou qual era a receita daquela sobremesa nova.
sentences.en: Dona Lúcia tasted it and asked what the recipe for that new dessert was.

sentences.pt: Rafael riu e contou o que tinha acontecido.
sentences.en: Rafael laughed and told her what had happened.

sentences.pt: Todos riram, e a avó disse que era a melhor sobremesa dos seus setenta anos.
sentences.en: Everyone laughed, and his grandmother said it was the best dessert of her seventy years.

questions.qEn: How old did Dona Lúcia turn?

questions.q: Qual era o problema do bolo?
questions.qEn: What was the problem with the cake?

sentences.pt: Gustavo e Larissa trabalhavam no mesmo escritório e almoçavam no centro toda sexta-feira.
sentences.en: Gustavo and Larissa worked in the same office and had lunch downtown every Friday.

sentences.pt: Naquela semana, decidiram conhecer um restaurante novo que tinha aberto perto da Avenida Paulista.
sentences.en: That week, they decided to try a new restaurant that had opened near Paulista Avenue.

sentences.pt: Larissa é vegetariana há cinco anos, por isso sempre lê o cardápio com cuidado.
sentences.en: Larissa has been vegetarian for five years, so she always reads the menu carefully.

sentences.pt: O garçom, um moço muito educado, disse que o melhor prato era o macarrão com legumes, o prato do dia.
sentences.en: The waiter, a very polite young man, said the best dish was the pasta with vegetables, the dish of the day.

sentences.pt: Gustavo pediu um peixe assado com arroz e salada.
sentences.en: Gustavo ordered a baked fish with rice and salad.

sentences.pt: Para beber, os dois escolheram suco de laranja, já que iam voltar para o trabalho.
sentences.en: To drink, the two of them chose orange juice, since they were going back to work.

sentences.pt: O restaurante estava lotado, e a comida demorou quase quarenta minutos para chegar.
sentences.en: The restaurant was packed, and the food took almost forty minutes to arrive.

sentences.pt: Quando o macarrão chegou, Larissa provou e sentiu um sabor estranho.
sentences.en: When the pasta arrived, Larissa tasted it and noticed a strange flavor.

sentences.pt: Embora estivesse com fome, ela parou de comer e olhou o prato com cuidado.
sentences.en: Although she was hungry, she stopped eating and looked at the dish carefully.

sentences.pt: Tinha presunto no meio do macarrão.
sentences.en: There was ham in the middle of the pasta.

sentences.pt: Gustavo chamou o garçom e explicou o problema.
sentences.en: Gustavo called the waiter and explained the problem.

sentences.pt: O garçom pediu desculpa muitas vezes e levou o prato para a cozinha.
sentences.en: The waiter apologized many times and took the dish to the kitchen.

sentences.pt: Alguns minutos depois, o cozinheiro veio até a mesa.
sentences.en: A few minutes later, the cook came to the table.

sentences.pt: Ele explicou que o prato do dia tinha mudado, mas que ninguém tinha avisado o garçom.
sentences.en: He explained that the dish of the day had changed, but no one had told the waiter.

sentences.pt: Ele ofereceu fazer um prato novo, só com legumes, azeite e queijo.
sentences.en: He offered to make a new dish, with only vegetables, olive oil and cheese.

sentences.pt: Larissa concordou, apesar de já estar um pouco atrasada.
sentences.en: Larissa agreed, despite already being a little late.

sentences.pt: O novo macarrão estava muito gostoso, e Larissa não precisou pagar o almoço.
sentences.en: The new pasta was very tasty, and Larissa didn't have to pay for lunch.

sentences.pt: Além disso, o cozinheiro mandou duas fatias de bolo de chocolate como sobremesa.
sentences.en: Besides that, the cook sent two slices of chocolate cake as dessert.

sentences.pt: Na hora de pagar a conta, Gustavo deixou uma boa gorjeta para o garçom.
sentences.en: When it was time to pay the bill, Gustavo left a good tip for the waiter.

sentences.pt: "Afinal, o erro não foi dele", disse.
sentences.en: "After all, the mistake wasn't his," he said.

sentences.pt: Larissa concordou e disse que eles voltariam na próxima sexta-feira.
sentences.en: Larissa agreed and said they would come back next Friday.

questions.q: Por que Larissa não come presunto?
O que o cozinheiro mandou para a mesa?
questions.qEn: What did the cook send to the table?
